text: Creatures now walk on the ground you see: on the medium and high settings their feet follow the small cubes of the slopes, with no more floating, sinking or hopping. When a frame comes late they keep walking instead of stopping and jumping ahead, and the Watch camera glides along with the one it follows instead of moving in little pushes. After Big Bang, the stardust and crystal land curves like the rest of the island and catches up within a few seconds, instead of staying as big earth blocks for a minute or two.
